replacements.TEST PÚBLICO → EXPOSICIÓN → PUNTUACIÓN →: PUBLIC TEST → EXPOSURE → SCORE → NEW EVIDENCE
replacements.Un benchmark pierde fuerza como prueba c: A benchmark loses strength as a test when it enters the optimization loop
replacements.La puntuación sigue siendo observable, p: The score remains observable, but it can mix capability with test exposure or repeated adaptation to the same target. The defense is not to ignore benchmarks: it is to refresh and separate the evidence.
replacements.Flujo causal desde un benchmark público: Causal flow from a public benchmark through contamination or over-optimization to refreshed evidence
replacements.Permiten comparar versiones bajo el mism: They let you compare versions under the same contract, but their content can eventually become known to the development loop.
replacements.El test toca entrenamiento o tuning: The test reaches training or tuning
replacements.Puede aparecer exacto o de forma semánti: It can appear exactly or in semantically similar form in data, prompts, model selection, or product iterations.
replacements.El score ya no identifica una sola causa: The score no longer identifies a single cause
replacements.Una mejora puede reflejar generalización: An improvement can reflect generalization, test familiarity, or adaptation to the criterion. Without additional evidence, those causes cannot be separated.
replacements.Renueva lo que el sistema no pudo optimi: Refresh what the system could not optimize against
replacements.el test entra en los datos o señales que: the test enters the data or signals used to build the system
Exact overlap is only one case. Detecting semantic contamination is harder, especially without access to the training corpus.
replacements.el test se convierte en objetivo repetid: the test becomes a repeated target of the development loop
replacements.No exige copiar el test en entrenamiento: This does not require copying the test into training. Reusing a static test as a selection target can reduce its value as independent evidence.
replacements.que un benchmark sea estándar no demuest: a benchmark being standard does not prove it remains independent of training
replacements.la puntuación necesita contexto sobre ex: the score needs context about exposure, date, protocol, and distribution
replacements.combina casos nuevos o privados con seña: combine new or private cases with executable signals and contamination analysis when possible
